about: The paste that spills (ADR-0050, item 3): a Consumer's declaration that range to one cell writes the block from that cell. The shape half; the Selection that follows is the grid's. From tests/ExGrid.Tests/SpillPasteTests.cs.

cases.name: ADR-0050 item 3 / DC-8: a block onto one cell, declared to spill, plans the block from that cell
ADR-0050 item 3 / DC-8: one plan, one range covering exactly the block, so the intent is one notification
ADR-0014 / DC-9: without the declaration, range to one cell keeps its refusal
ADR-0050 item 3 / DC-10: a block reaching past the last row is refused by name
ADR-0050 item 3 / DC-10: a block reaching past the last column is refused by name
ADR-0050 item 3: a block ending exactly on the last row and column fits
ADR-0050 item 3 / ADR-0035 / DC-10: Editable is judged on the spilled block, not only the cell pasted on
ADR-0035's order: "may not" before "cannot": a locked column in the block outranks the edge
ADR-0050 item 3: every other shape rule of ADR-0014 stands under the declaration
ADR-0014 / ADR-0050: one value onto one cell is not a spill: it writes that cell
